title: Your iManage, in Legora
summary: Teach the Agent how you work. Skills let legal teams encode their standards, processes and preferences inside the Legora aOS™.
body_markdown:
Your day-to-day work runs through iManage: the document you’re reviewing, the draft you’re working on, the documents for your current matter. With our new iManage integration, firms on iManage Cloud can access those matters, folders, and documents directly inside Legora. Find what you need, work on it with the Agent, and save the result back to iManage.


No uploading. No downloading. No manual syncing.


#### **Why this integration is different**


Many integrations with a DMS work like a file picker. You browse to a document, pull a copy into the tool, and do your work there. That copy now lives outside the DMS. It drifts from the latest version, sits outside your firm's governance, and has to be manually synced back when you're done. The integration saves a few clicks, but the work still happens in two places.


We built it to be better.


Your documents stay where they belong. In iManage, fully accessible in Legora. You don't have to find the right file and hand it to the Agent. The Agent can search your iManage the way your firm has organized it, by client, matter, author, and your own custom fields. Then it reads what it finds, drafts from it, and puts the result back where it came from.


That changes what the Agent can do for you. Finding documents, editing them, and saving the updated version used to be three separate jobs across two systems. Now they happen in one conversation. And because every step runs on the permissions and versioning your firm already relies on, you get the speed without giving up control of your documents.


**Legora + iManage**


**Standard integration**


Documents stay in iManage


Pulls a copy out of iManage


The Agent searches by client, matter, author, and your custom fields


You find the file and hand it over


Saves back as a new version or new document


Manually sync changes back when you're done


Find, draft, and file in one conversation


Work happens in two places


#### **What's new**


**Connected files.** Link an iManage matter to a Legora project and its folders and documents are right there. You can browse them, preview them, and bring them into your work without leaving Legora.


**Ask the Agent.** You don't need document numbers or exact field names. Ask the Agent in plain language and it searches your iManage by client, matter, author, date, or recent activity. It understands your firm's own iManage fields, and every answer links back to the source document.


**Edit and save back.** The Agent can draft from a precedent or revise a Word document, with every change shown as a tracked change. When you're happy with it, save it back to iManage as a new version or a new document.


#### **Built on your existing governance**


Everything runs on each user's own iManage permissions, so the Agent only sees what you can already see. It never saves anything on its own: you review the edits and decide what goes back. iManage stays your system of record.


#### **Try asking**


-


"What iManage documents did I work on recently?"


-


"Find a precedent term sheet for a joint development deal."


-


"Search across my matters for indemnification language."


#### **Getting started**


The integration is available now for iManage Cloud customers. Once it's enabled for your organization, each user connects their iManage account in Legora's integration settings. Talk to your Legora team to get it switched on.
